external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Americold’s new Kansas City Import-Export Hub, developed in partnership with Canadian Pacific Kansas City, connects us directly to the CPKC rail network. Located inside the intermodal terminal, this hub enables a direct, seamless connection between the U.S., Mexico, and Canada. Our agreements with USDA, FDA, SENASICA, and CBP to perform inspections and pre-clearance bypass border congestion.

Americold is making history with the first cold chain Import-Export Hub in Canada to connect road, rail, and sea at a port. Uniting DP World’s port operations and CPKC’s rail solutions strengthens global trade flows and expands export and import capacity. Our Port Saint John solution creates a more efficient connection between Canada and its global trading partners by establishing cold chain infrastructure and opening up trade lanes through eastern Canada.

Americold’s new Dubai facility, developed with RSA Cold Chain and DP World, marks our first Middle East site and a key advancement in optimizing food flows across the region.

History-making projects include a cold storage facility at the Port of Jebel Ali in Dubai (part of Americold’s joint venture with RSA Global) and a first-of-its kind cold storage facility located at the Port of Saint John in New Brunswick, Canada.
